question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Paralysed
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. Healthy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"paralysed"** means unable to move or act; affected by paralysis. (असहाय)

 
 
• **Example: **After the accident, he was paralysed from the waist down.
 
 
 
• **"Healthy" **refers to being in good health, free from illness or injury. (स्वस्थ)
 
 
• **Example: **She follows a balanced diet to stay healthy and fit.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'paralysed' **is **'healthy'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 i.e. Healthy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Demure **(संकोची): Reserved, modest, and shy.

 
 
• **Example:** Her demure smile caught everyone's attention at the party.
 
 
 
• **Stifled **(दमित): To prevent or constrain an action or emotion.
 
 
• **Example: **She stifled a laugh during the serious meeting.
 
 
 
• **Sultry** (उमस भरा): Hot and humid weather.
 
 
• **Example:** The sultry summer afternoon made everyone feel lethargic.
